note: Effort rejection captures (2026-10-22, 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-25), one entry per effort rejection fixture, keyed by its <dialect>/<case> path under rejections/. lane is the carrier the request went to; model is the model id sent. request_shape is the sent wire body projected onto its effort field and its thinking object, at their wire paths: output_config.effort (Messages and InvokeModel), additionalModelRequestFields.output_config.effort (Converse), reasoning.effort (Responses). Every entry carries exactly one effort path. A request_shape with no thinking key means no thinking object was sent; a thinking key holds the thinking object as sent. Everything else in the sent body is left out: in particular the InvokeModel opus-4-5 pair differs only by the effort anthropic_beta flag, which the beta case's fixture note names. status and message are the captured status and the verbatim upstream message; the fixture body is the full envelope.
